justification: Assessment reported INVALID and pinpointed step 8's claim that edges of G outside the critical subgraph H can be oriented arbitrarily without creating a directed path longer than k -- exactly the ground-truth flaw. Its counterexample (C_5 with pendant path u1-x-y-z, k=3, orienting u1->x->y->z to get a directed path on >3 vertices) is a different-but-valid witness for the same claim as the ground truth's P3/k=2 witness.
